tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers only H≤0.48, whereas the target is H=22. The slow-horizon probe directly tests and calibrates the indicated sink-coupled reversal.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Short-horizon trajectory measurements would not resolve the long-horizon reversal; the coupled-lag signature is absent.
The specified high-gradient probe is unavailable, while the explicit co-activation guidance identifies the slow-horizon probe as the first discriminating measurement.
Five short-horizon rows cannot reliably identify the slow adaptation timescale at the target horizon.
